description: PBES2-HS256+A128KW on a P-256 key and an oct key returns the oct key; decided by ADR 0054 §2.1 (family): PBES2 is served by an oct key only (its k is the password, RFC 7518 §4.8), and an asymmetric key is never returned for it; member 1 has no alg, use (U = enc) or key_ops, and the selector has no kid; outcome hand-derived from the ADR 0054 text (conformance/tools/jwk-oracle/specs/select.json), never computed by polyjose
